questions.stem: A user with a new home laptop wants to encrypt their drive but the system runs Windows 11 Home. Which feature can they use?

choices.text: They must upgrade to Windows 11 Pro

questions.explanation: Windows 11 Home includes Device Encryption, a consumer-grade equivalent to BitLocker. Recovery info is stored in the user's Microsoft account.
questions.trap: BitLocker is NOT available on Home. The exam wants you to know Device Encryption is the Home-edition answer.

questions.stem: A small business needs a Windows edition that can join an Active Directory domain, use BitLocker, and host Remote Desktop sessions. Which is the LEAST expensive option that meets all three needs?
questions.explanation: Pro is the lowest tier that supports domain join, BitLocker, and Remote Desktop server. Home lacks all three.
questions.trap: Enterprise also has the features but requires volume licensing - more expensive than Pro.

questions.stem: A workstation needs 4 TB of RAM for a data-analysis workload. Which Windows edition is the MINIMUM that supports this?

choices.text: Windows 10 Pro for Workstations (6 TB max)

questions.explanation: Windows 10 Pro for Workstations supports up to 6 TB of RAM. Pro caps at 2 TB; Home caps at 128 GB.
questions.trap: (d) is false - every edition has its own RAM cap.

questions.stem: An admin needs to apply group policies to control settings on a single Windows 11 machine without using a domain controller. Which tool do they open?
questions.explanation: gpedit.msc opens the Local Group Policy Editor for the current machine. Available in Pro and higher.
questions.trap: gpmc.msc is the Group Policy Management Console for an Active Directory environment. The question says 'without a domain controller'.

questions.stem: A user in Germany received a 'Windows 11 Pro N' license. After installing, video files won't play in any Microsoft app. What is the cause?

choices.text: Pro N requires a separate codec license from Microsoft
N editions ship without media playback utilities; install the Media Feature Pack
Windows 11 Pro N is a 32-bit edition and the video files are 64-bit
Pro N is region-locked and the videos are from outside Germany

questions.explanation: Windows N editions ship without Windows Media Player and other multimedia utilities. Install the Media Feature Pack via Settings > Apps > Optional Features.
questions.trap: Other answers invent restrictions that don't exist. The N is purely about bundled media components.

questions.stem: A help desk tech needs to remotely control a colleague's desktop running Windows 11 Home for troubleshooting. The remote machine should host the session. What is the issue?

choices.text: Windows 11 Home cannot host an RDP session; it can only be a client
RDP requires BitLocker to be enabled
Both endpoints must be on the same domain
Windows Defender Firewall blocks RDP by default and must be disabled

questions.explanation: RDP server (host) is a Pro+ feature. Home can only initiate RDP sessions as a client, not host them.
questions.trap: Disabling the firewall isn't required to use RDP; the firewall has explicit RDP rules.

questions.stem: Match each Windows feature to the LOWEST edition that supports it.
questions.explanation: Each row shows the minimum edition with that feature. Memorizing these is the heart of 1.3.

questions.stem: Which statements about Windows 11 are TRUE? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Home edition can join an Active Directory domain

questions.explanation: Windows 11 is 64-bit only (a), includes Copilot (b), and requires TPM 2.0 + Secure Boot (d). Home cannot join a domain - that's still a Pro+ feature.
questions.trap: (c) is the consistent gate across BOTH Windows 10 and Windows 11 Home. Home never joins domains.

questions.stem: Which Windows edition is the LOWEST that supports the Resilient File System (ReFS) for desktop use in Windows 11?
questions.explanation: Windows 11 Enterprise supports ReFS on the desktop side, matching what's in Windows Server.
questions.trap: Pro for Workstations is the Windows 10 path to ReFS; on Windows 11 it's Enterprise.
